title: slot-coalescence-bank-smoothing: reduce micro-fragmentation in continuous batcher
author: Ava Martinez
release_notes: Introduce 'slot coalescence bank' to group sub-threshold micro-batches, smoothing admission credits and jittered soft-timeouts. Improves tail latency and throughput with safe rollback and feature flag.
description: Motivation: continuous_batcher suffered from micro-slot fragmentation under bursty, small-request workloads. Small requests frequently became isolated slots and prevented efficient KV cache pin warmups; combined with sharp credit decay this produced starvation for medium-size requests and higher P99 tail. Our goal was to reduce fragmentation without increasing average latency or violating SLOs. Solution summary: introduce a lightweight 'slot coalescence bank' (coalesce_bank) that temporarily accepts sub-threshold partial slots for short adaptive windows, re-emit them as consolidated slots when either (a) enough compatible slots arrive, (b) a jittered soft-timeout expires, or (c) a precedence credit threshold is hit. Key elements: 1) coalesce_bank: a bounded per-worker ring that indexes partial slots by locality keys (KV pin fingerprint + model variant) and arrival age; entries are mergeable when combined token count < target_batch_size*1.2 and model/kernel affinity matches. 2) smoothing of admission credits: credit decay function replaced with a two-stage exponential->linear decay to avoid abrupt de-prioritization after transient bursts. 3) jittered adaptive soft-timeouts: soft timeouts are jittered per-coalesce key using a hash-based offset to avoid synchronized flush storms. 4) KV pin-awareness: when pins are present, bank holds higher-priority merges for a slightly longer hold window to improve cache warmup benefit. 5) safety knobs: feature-flag gating, bounded memory accounting, and a fast-path bypass for hard-deadline requests (deadline flag present). Implementation notes: changes are localized to continuous_batcher/scheduler.go and a new continuous_batcher/coalesce_bank.go with 280 lines of implementation and unit tests; runtime/kv_cache/pinning.go updated to expose a non-blocking hint API; metrics and tracing hooks added to metrics/batcher_metrics.go and tracing/span_tags.go; a perf harness and benchmark slot_coalesce_benchmark.go added under perf/bench. Observability: new metrics coalesce.bank.size, coalesce.bank.merge_count, coalesce.bank.expire_flush_count, admission.credit_smoothness_ratio. Benchmarks and results: controlled perf lab (8xA100 nodes) using mixed small/medium chat workload. Compared to main baseline: - 12% P99 reduction on total request latency for mixed burst workloads - 9% median latency improvement for microburst scenarios - 18% throughput improvement at same tail latency target (SLO: P99 < 220ms) - KV pin hit-rate improved by +7 percentage points during warmup phases. Safety and regressions: initial canary revealed a race in coalesce_bank eviction path (fixed in follow-up commit by adding cooperative backoff and a CAS-protected index). Load tests at scale (staging cluster) show no change to memory P95 and acceptable additional metric cardinality. Testing: unit tests for merge semantics and edge cases; deterministic fuzz tests for timeout jitter; integration canary against dedicated pool; end-to-end perf harness. Rollout plan: behind feature flag 'coalesce_bank_v1' with staged rollout: 5% -> 25% -> 75% -> 100% per-region with automated rollback on >5% P99 regression or >1% request error increase. Documentation: docs/cookbook/slot_coalescence.md added with explanation of flags and tuning knobs. Checklist: - [x] design doc + perf plan referenced in ENG-2984 - [x] unit + fuzz tests - [x] staging canary run - [x] metrics + alerts updated - [x] feature flag gating - [x] rollback plan

notes: Feature-flagged improvement to continuous batching that coalesces sub-threshold slots to reduce fragmentation and improve KV cache warmup; contains safeguards for deadlines and bounded memory. Follow-up work: explore adaptive bank sizing (ENG-3021) and kernel-specific affinity hints.
benchmarks: See perf/bench/slot_coalesce_benchmark.go output: baseline P99 262ms -> coalesce P99 231ms; throughput at P99 target increased by 18%; KV pin warmup hit rate +7pp.
risk_assessment: Low-medium: guarded by feature flag, bounded memory and two fast-path bypasses. Initial race fixed; older runtimes should be unaffected. No breaking API changes.
rollback_instructions: flip feature flag 'coalesce_bank_v1' off; if persistent regressions occur, revert commit hash <squash-commit-hash> and re-deploy.
